rows.label: tlk001201_05_msg0001
rows.name:
I have done you all a great
disservice. Please allow me
to offer my apologies...

rows.label: tlk001201_05_msg0002
rows.name:
Records say the third sword that draws
Heaven's Holy Grail's power is sealed
somewhere in Liberalitas Archipelago.

rows.label: tlk001201_05_msg0003
rows.name:
The power of Heaven's Holy
Grail... I entrust it to you.

rows.label: tlk001201_05_msg0004
rows.name:
Zeke. I am entrusting you with
the duty of guarding Heaven's
Holy Grail and the boy.

rows.label: tlk001201_05_msg0005
rows.name:
I chose to believe in that
boy's eyes. We cannot allow
that light to be extinguished.

rows.label: tlk001201_05_msg0006
rows.name:
You can leave it to
Thunderclap Zeke!

rows.label: tlk001201_05_msg0007
rows.name:
Jokes like that are why you still
have so much to learn.
